pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Moose is a GTK4/libadwaita desktop client for chatting with large language models served by Ollama. It keeps conversations in a local SQLite database with full-text search, can attach PDFs (text is extracted with Poppler's pdftotext) and images for vision models, and renders Markdown and LaTeX in replies.
It does not run models itself: point it at a local or remote Ollama instance. GPU acceleration is therefore a property of the Ollama server, not of this package.
